assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Edit image 1 (current Med Auto Practice logo). Images 2 and 3 (Med Auto Science and Med Auto Grant) are style and exact family-proportion references. Output one square app tile, 1024x1024 visually. Preserve the same opaque off-white paper rounded tile, restrained soft bevel and shadow, very pale blue dot grid, and the same external circular trajectory seen in images 2 and 3: deep blue upper-left arc, teal upper-right arc, sky-blue lower arc, centered top and lower-left gaps, ONE amber ring junction just right of middle with deep-blue center. Match family ring width, light, margin, line weight and subtle colored-pencil grain. Replace only the busy central symbol in image 1 with one compact upright clinical clipboard in dark ink, two modest short chart lines and one clearly legible teal check mark integrated on the face of the clipboard. The clipboard has a small blue top clip, clearly distinct from the folded-corner generic science and grant papers. Leave enough negative space between clipboard and ring. No stethoscope, no separate round badge, no additional symbol, no text or letters. The board is the only central silhouette. Well-centered with visual weight like the siblings, recognizable at 32 px, polished and sober.

Six main cards, left to right (use short stacked lines to fit):

2 "Patient" / "Records"

4 "Clinician" / "Review"
5 "System" / "Entry"
6 "Result" / "Verification"
Three supporting cards below, left to right:
"Patient & Encounter"
"Source & Time"
"Access & Review"
